e.title: imaginator
e.summary: 保险组合与损失模拟 R 包（CAS 官方，CRAN）：保单/损失/损失进展模拟，确定性/随机留存与增长情景
e.summary_en: Insurance portfolio and loss simulation R package (CAS official, CRAN): simulate policies, losses and loss emergence with deterministic/stochastic retention and growth scenarios
e.summary_hk: 保險組合與損失模擬 R 包（CAS 官方，CRAN）：保單/損失/損失進展模擬，確定性/隨機留存與增長情景
e.body: imaginator（CAS 官方，CRAN）模拟一般保险的保单、损失与损失进展：确定性/随机留存与增长情景、索赔发生与结算时间分布——准备金与定价研究的组合模拟器。对 RIAA：组合层面的损失模拟——与 [[synthetic]]（SynthETIC 个体索赔模拟，已收录）配套：SynthETIC 管个体索赔，imaginator 管组合/保单层；模拟组合是测试准备金与定价方法的标准手段（模型已知真值）；CAS 官方维护背书；与 [[chainladder-python]] 配合做端到端模拟→准备金实验。
e.body_en: imaginator (CAS official, CRAN) simulates general insurance policies, losses and loss emergence: deterministic/stochastic retention and growth scenarios, claim inception and settlement timing distributions — a portfolio simulator for reserving and pricing research. For RIAA: portfolio-level loss simulation — pairs with [[synthetic]] (SynthETIC individual claim simulator, already in wiki): SynthETIC handles individual claims, imaginator handles the portfolio/policy layer; simulated portfolios are the standard way to test reserving and pricing methods (known ground truth); CAS official maintenance; pairs with [[chainladder-python]] for end-to-end simulate-then-reserve experiments.
e.body_hk: imaginator（CAS 官方，CRAN）模擬一般保險的保單、損失與損失進展：確定性/隨機留存與增長情景、索賠發生與結算時間分佈——準備金與定價研究的組合模擬器。對 RIAA：組合層面的損失模擬——與 [[synthetic]]（SynthETIC 個體索賠模擬，已收錄）配套：SynthETIC 管個體索賠，imaginator 管組合/保單層；模擬組合是測試準備金與定價方法的標準手段（模型已知真值）；CAS 官方維護背書；與 [[chainladder-python]] 配合做端到端模擬→準備金實驗。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：CAS 官方 repo + CRAN（组合/损失模拟能力），未实测
